nom: Drunk Elephant C-Luma Hydrabright Gentle Vitamin C Serum

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again
avis.texte: I have been using vitamin c for many years now and this is the best product I used. It's lightweight, brightens the skin perfectly and doesn't cause any irritation.
There was nothing in the container I am highly dissatisfied and disappointed I sent it back and still awaiting my refund. Next step will be to dispute with bank. This product seems like fraud
I usually have an issue with vitamin C causing redness around my mouth and nose area but this one really works with my sensitive skin.

I have the opposite of sensitive skin, but I kept getting HIVES when using this. I figured out that it was only when I used my Cetaphil Moisturizing Lotion did I get actual hives. Without, it was fine but still a tiny bit itchy.

I needed to replace my Vitamin C serum that I was using for awhile. It didn't seem to work but didn't break my skin out - as I have very sensitive skin. When I read the reviews on this one, I was hopeful. And I'm glad I tried it. Just a few weeks in and my skin looks great. And no reactions to it, which is a bonus!

The other DE vitamin c serum is a 10/10 this one not at all. No results, peels, even started waiting 20 minutes to fully absord still the same. I will stick with the other vitamin c serum from drunk elephant.

This serum was given to me by a friend after I said I was looking to add vitamin c to my routine. I was skeptical at first as I've had bad luck with Drunk Elephant in the past, but I'm so glad I decided to try it My skin looks hydrated, bright, and glowy, and the best part is NO breakouts!! My skin tends to hate serums and I break out really easily, but I've been using this for a few weeks and my skin has had no new breakouts. Definitely give this a try!!

avis.titre: Smells like cereal on your face
avis.texte: Had high hopes for this lotion because of the good reviews. First of all, it smells like Golden Grahams cereal smeared all over your face (i'm not kidding here). Second of all, it did not mesh well with my other face products. Also, didn't notice any differece after several weeks of use.

I have tried wvery Vitamin C serum at Ulta and this ine is hands doen the best! Gives your skin an instantnluminous glow. Can be worn under makeup and actually makes a great offlabel primer! Ill be using this until the day I die
iv added this to my skin care routine, it's only been a week but my skin looks so bright and healthy. iv noticed a huge difference immediately!

I use this product 3 times per week after cleansing/showering. I love the way it makes my face feel! I'm new to using vitamin c so I am starting slow. I will eventually work my way up to using this daily.

avis.titre: One of my all time favorite products!
avis.texte: This is my second time purchasing this item and it will continue to be one that I re-purchase again and again. It's extremely lightweight and doesn't have a bad smell to it. I use it morning and night.
Feels nice. To soon to be sure if differing from more aggressive vitamin c is worth the trade off, but no complaints
Such a great texture and it makes my skin glowy. But, every time I use my face breaks out! So so sad. :(
This is my second purchase of this product and I love the glow it gives my skin - perfect for adding into my La La cream for a skin smoothie.

I normally use the C-Firma vitamin C serum but decided to give this one a chance since I've been trying to be more gentle with my skin. I can say that my pores look smaller and skin more bouncy throughout the day, it's only been a week or two, so my hyperpigmentation hasn't changed enough for my naked eye to see yet.

I received a small sample of this C-Luma Hydrabright Gentle Vitamin C Serum and discovered that it truly makes a difference in how smooth my skin looks. This is now one of my top priority facial products. It is one of the most effective products I've ever tried.
Love the way it feels, smells and nurtures my face. Will definitely be buying this again!

I was so pleasantly surprised with this. I love serums in general, but I felt like the results were within the first use and I'm just so much happier with how my skin is looking. My cousin mentioned to me two weeks after using this product. I don't know what you're doing, but your skin is just looking so good. 🙃

avis.titre: I will buy this product over and over again!!
avis.texte: I use this product every morning for my daily glow up and I absolutely love it!! I have really dry and oily skin, am 50 years old and still break out, and this is the first product I have found that does not make me break out!! I am 100% completely sold on this product. Love, love, love this product!!

Im obsessed. I tried this on in the store on my way out and placed an online order for it less than 24 hours later. It makes my skin look like glass but not greasy. Love it. I live in the high desert mountains where it is DRY and this is so hydrating.

avis.titre: Give it try, won't be disappointed!
avis.texte: Another great addition to any smoothy. I had one of the deluxe samples and it got me hooked! So I had to buy a full size. I add it to protini at bed time and have noticed a big difference with my poor, tone and complexion. I have super sensitive/combination skin, I still break out some and this stuff takes care of that. Have never been able to really use a Vitamin C product before. I've noticed some of my sun spots have faded as well.
Was hesitant to buy due to the price, but I don't regret it one bit. Been using for about 2 months and it's the best my skin has looked in a while. Even my dermatologist said I have beautiful skin!

I was looking for something to replace my tatcha brightening serum because I don't like it since they changed the formula. This is very close to what they use to be so I am happy. Full transparency, I don't have problem skin at all. Good genetics but I love the glow this gives and I love the top of the bottle as well. No waste when you pump it out. So overall, I'm happy with the product ☺️

avis.titre: Made my make up pill and flake
avis.texte: It made my makeup pill up and flake off, only brand Ive had do this
I deceided to take a shot at this because I absolutely loved there Hydra serum and there polypeptide cream but this serum is the worst thing ever .
Been using it a week and I already have my skin more whited and clear. Bit expensive but it's worth it

I absolutely adore how lightweight this product feels on my skin—it's incredibly gentle too! The packaging is adorable, making it a joy to use every day. The texture is simply perfect; it glides on effortlessly and sinks in quickly, leaving my skin feeling refreshed. This amazing 10% vitamin C serum not only brightens but also clarifies and hydrates, giving my complexion a beautiful, even glow. It's a game changer for achieving that radiant, luminous look! The container does leak if you don't leave it sitting up however, that's the only reason I have it four stars.

avis.auteur: Do not want my name posted
avis.texte: I have never used it before. The agent on the chat recommended it. I just hope the top works better than it did on Portini serum.

This is definitely a keeper in my skincare routine . I have dark spots and I have been diligently using this product and it has been fading my spots . This serums also provide a lot of moisture to my face.

This drunk elephant serum is wonderful. I have some pigmentations due to acne scars and this helps a lot. My skin feels and looks a lot smoother. I use this serum once a day in the morning. Highly recommended

i've been using this every morning and i love it! my skin immediately looks refreshed radiant and awake the formula is super light and not sticky or oily. i wear it under a moisturizer and it is perfect

I have tried many vitamin C, serums and creams in my past and this one is average. I would say it is not as concentrated as some I have tried. This is a great formula to introduce vitamin C into your skincare if you haven't before!

I am really enjoying this Drunk Elephant serum. It goes on super smooth and absorbs quickly. It does not leave any sticky residue after it absorbs and my face is ready for my moisturizer. My skin is looking smooth and silky after continued use.

This serum was such a great surprise!! I'm not a vitamin C lover because I notice my skin seems weird… but I give it a chance with this formula and it's so good!! It's not like other formulas! It's very light weight and leave a healthy finish! The texture on my cheeks it's less visible and my skin looks radiant! I like it!!

To preface, this was my intro to vitamin C and I haven't used this product for super long. With that being said, I love the packaging for being so innovative, hygienic, and fun to use. The consistency is creamy and smooth and doesn't feel tacky on my skin. I see the effects of it in the brightness of my skin, but I haven't seen too much of a difference in my acne spots. But again, it might be due to needing more time to see results. So far, so good!

This serum is super hydrating and it has overall helped brighten my complexion. I love the packaging it is so chic and easy to use. The serum has no smell and you only have to use a little bit. Absolutely love it

I love everything from this brand that I have used so far so I was very excited to try this new serum. It instantly hydrates my skin and leaves it looking glowy while also getting deep into my pores and not just sitting on top of my face. I love using it before makeup for extra hydration

I have been using drunk elephant products for years and this one honestly is my favorite. I have used maybe three or four bottles of this and I continue to purchase it because it really works wonders.

This serum does wonders! It's my second bottle and so far I'm loving it. My skin feels very hydrated and it has also cleared out my skin. I love the fact that it contains vitamin C. Overall, this will continue to be my go to.

I've been testing the Drunk Elephant C-Luma Hydrabright Serum, and it's a standout for reviving dull skin! The lightweight texture absorbs quickly, leaving my skin visibly brighter and smoother. The potent dose of vitamin C works wonders, but what I love most is how hydrating it feels without being sticky or heavy. It layers beautifully under makeup, making it perfect for my morning routine. If you're dealing with uneven tone or lackluster skin, this serum might be your new go-to. Just remember to wear sunscreen during the day to amplify its benefits! Would I repurchase? Absolutely yes!

I was looking for a new vitamin C serum and this one does not disappoint. It's gentle on my skin and has not caused any irritation. I love that it's such a big bottle and Drunk Elephant always has the best packaging!

I have dry mature skin and don't usually have any problems with Vitamin C, and happy to report that I didn't experience any issues with this one. I do love the cute and practical packaging with the pump. The serum is not sticky and absorbs easily.

This is my first drunk elephant product- I can't say I'm a super fan yet but the ingredients do peak my interest! I love that this is unscented vitamin c and the packaging is so cool and great for travel. My only con so far is the texture is a bit sticky for me but definitely will continue to use.

avis.titre: Leaves the skin looking glowy and healthy!
avis.texte: Automatically became my favorite! It's such a light serum that leaves your skin looking a feeling so moisturized! I love that it's a vitamin c serum it gives the skin looking healthy and so glowy. Definitely a must have.

After I turned 40, my skin went crazy! I never had acne in my teen years but now I have horrible breakouts that leave dark scars. I also have hyperpigmentation from the sun damage my skin got in the 90s. The Drunk Elephant C-Luma Hydrabright Serum has helped my skin so much. It has improved my acne and scarring. It has dramatically lightened my hyperpigmentation. My skin looks more radiant and has a healthy glow. My skin feels more hydrated and my fine lines are less noticeable too.

I've been using Drunk Elephant's C-Luma Hydrating Serum for a few weeks, and I love it! It feels lightweight and absorbs quickly without any stickiness. My skin looks brighter and feels super hydrated. No irritation at all, and the subtle scent is a plus. Definitely a favorite in my routine!

I absolutely love Drunk Elephant and this serum is no exception! My skin looks healthy, hydrated and so much brighter. I love the gel texture as well. It looks great on its own, for a natural look, but also works well under makeup!

My skin loves this serum way more than the other vitamin C one from Drunk Elephant. For starters, it feels gentler on my skin and doesn't need any special setup. The texture is almost gel-like, and I'm so glad it's not a dropper, it feels so much more hygienic with the pump. It's supposed to be great for acne, and while my skin isn't acne-prone, it reacted really well to it. My skin feels smoother, more balanced, and I love using it in the evening. It's like I wake up with brighter, happier skin. Overall, it's an amazing vitamin C serum, especially for sensitive skin.

This is a cream serum that can help reduces redness,dullness,uneven texture , blemishes and dark spots. After few days of using this product i noticed the difference on my skin. I used to have uneven texture on my face but now it's starting to feel smooth. It wouldn't show a drastic changes right away so I'm gonna continue using this product till I ran out. After applying vitamin c serum it's better to follow it with moisturizer if you are applying it at night and sunscreen if applying it in the morning.

This serum is a great addition to my routine. The vitamin C helps brighten my complexion, and it provides lasting hydration without feeling heavy. It's also helped even out my skin tone over time. Simple, effective, and easy to incorporate into daily use

So I've been using C-Luma Hydra Right Serum for a month, and it's amazing! My skin feels hydrated and plump, and the texture is so lightweight—it absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. The glow is real! Highly recommend for anyone needing a boost of hydration and radiance in their routine

I'm obsessed with this vitamin c serum! It is really light on the skin and leaves my face looking so healthy and glossy! I recommend trying this if your looking for brighter skin and have from discoloration!

Wow. I love this stuff. Like truly. First of all it smells like honey which I love (but not in an overpowering way don't fear). It leaves my skin moisturized & smooth & has seemed to be clearing it up as well!!

The Drunk Elephant C-Luma is a lightweight, gentle serum infused with vitamin C. It's non-irritating and offers a subtle hydrating effect. While it feels a bit tacky on initial application, it quickly absorbs into the skin. The serum helps to brighten the complexion and minimize hyperpigmentation. Gifted by DE.

Love it! I have a ton of sun spots all over my face and really needed something to help. I have been applying this daily and definitely see results! It absorbs well and doesn't feel too sticky. My skin so much more hydrated right away after using it and my face is brighter.

Right off the bat, I noticed the light, silky texture that feels luxurious as it glides onto my skin. It's not greasy or heavy, which is a big plus for me, especially since I layer skincare products. Overall, I'd say the C-Luna Hydrabright Serum lives up to its name. It brightens and hydrates, giving my skin a noticeable glow that I love. If you're looking for a serum that's effective and gentle enough for regular use, this is a great option. I highly recommend. 🤍

I always love my drunk elephant products and this is no different! I started incorporating vitamin C into my skincare routine last year and it's made a big difference in the brightness of my skin. This specific one has elevated that and my skin looks even better!

Okay, I'm obsessed with the packaging on this serum! The Drunk Elephant C-Luma Hydrabright Serum has a pump design that is perfect: no mess, no spills, and it just feels super satisfying to use. The serum itself glides on so smoothly, and there's zero tackiness after. It's hydrating and works wonders on brightening up my skin. I love mixing a few drops with my moisturizer or SPF, and it makes a noticeable difference on those dull-skin days. Plus, it's got all the good stuff to help with sun damage and fine lines, so it's like a little confidence boost in a bottle. Highly recommend if you're looking for something to give your skin that extra glow!

Oh my God, I am literally obsessed!! I was worried because I've tried so many other Vitamin C serums, but they irritated my skin since I have sensitive skin. However, this one has been amazing! It suits my skin so much better, and I'm so happy with the results. It's light on the skin and doesn't leave me feeling sticky, which I love. This serum has really helped brighten my skin tone, reduce my hyperpigmentation, and even out my overall texture.

recently tried the C-Luma Hydrabright Serum by Drunk Elephant, and it's fantastic! This serum has a gentle 10% vitamin C blend that brightens and hydrates my skin without any irritation. After a few weeks, I noticed a significant improvement in my skin's clarity and a reduction in blemishes. It's perfect for anyone looking to achieve a luminous, even complexion

As a previous time user of the C-Firma serum from drunk Elephant I am loving this gentler, more beginner friendly alternative. C-Luma-it feels more hydrating than the original vitamin C, and it's leaves my skin luminous without stickiness. It's also easy to tolerate- even with lots of other actives in my routine, I don't experience any irritation while using C-Luma. My only critique is the packaging and the pump, inconsistent because the product can cause it to crust over.

I've heard great things about this brand, so I was so excited to get to try this new product. First impressions: I truly love the dispenser. You twist the top and up pops a pump, which dispenses exactly the right amount with just one pump. The serum feels great on my skin. It's thicker and more lotion-like than some serums I have tried, and it feels really hydrating right away. No fragrance at all, which I like. I love a good Vitamin C serum and this is a great one because it's hydrating at the same time. Works well under makeup, hasn't caused any irritation. I love it!

Drunk elephant is one of my favorite brands. So of curse I had to try c Luma. And of course it did not disappoint. Beautiful packaging with such beautiful ingredients that actually work. I love this serum!

This is a really nice serum. Very lightweight and glides on easily it doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky and is actually hydrating. I haven't experienced any redness or irritation from this either, very pleased

I was super excited to try out this Hydrabright serum. I love all drunk elephant products and this one is amazing! It made my skin glow and i also feel like it did help my skin clear up some! I definitely recommend trying this out!

I must admit that I love this serum! It makes my skin feel so soft and smooth after I apply it. This serum is a great alternative for anyone that is very sensitive to vitamin C. It's incredibly gentle on your skin! So far I've noticed that my skin is looking a little brighter. I'm excited to see how well this makes my skin look after a couple of months!

I've been using C-Luma for a while, and I can definitely see a difference in my skin. My face looks brighter, and the texture feels smoother, especially in areas where I had some unevenness. It took a few weeks to really notice the changes, but once I did, it was clear. I love that it helps with hydration too—it doesn't leave my skin dry at all. Overall, it's been a nice addition to my routine, especially for those dealing with dullness or dark spots.

The Drunk Elephant C-Luma Hydrabright Serum does not burn my skin or seem to cause irritation. It feels like it's non-drying — in fact it appears to improve my skin's overall level of hydration. Apparently, it has sodium hyaluronate, squalane and marula oil which "help prevent moisture loss." Over time, the 10% Vitamin C in the formula is supposed to help with brightening and firming. Longterm I cannot wait to see if it helps with my hyperpigmentation! I received this product in exchange for my review for test and review purposes.

This is the product I have been on the hunt for! My skin has been feeling a little dull and after my first use I have seen immediate results! It's the perfect brightening serum to start your day off right!

I love this vitamin c serum! It feels light on my skin when I apply it in the morning after washing my face before moisturizer. It doesn't have a scent which I appreciate and feels clean. This was my first drunk elephant product and I'm hooked!

I absolutely love this serum, and it's been a game-changer for my skin! The vitamin C in it really brightens and evens out my complexion, giving my skin a noticeable glow. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly, which I love for layering with other products. After a few uses, I've noticed my skin feels smoother and looks more radiant overall.

I am loving using this product! It's brightening and makes your skin feel hydrated, it's easy to use and I like the packaging. I love to have glowing skin so I am always looking to add products to my skincare routine that can do that.

Love this vitamin c ! I've used the other vitamin c from drunk elephant and found this one is even more gentle and the texture is nicer too. So far I've noticed that my skin has become brighter. Loving it!

I love this serum it contains vitamin c , which is really good for our skin. It definitely feels super lightweight. It doesn't feel like you're wearing anything after applying it and I love it. It's definitely been a morning skin routine using this product.

I'm loving Drunk Elephant's C-Luma Hydrabright Serum! It's super gentle, even on my combination skin and the hydration is a huge plus—no dryness or irritation like I've had with other vitamin C serums. After just a few days, my skin already looks more radiant, and my dark spots seem a bit lighter. It feels lightweight, layers well with other products, and has made my skin noticeably smoother and brighter. Definitely a keeper!

The Drunk Elephant C-Firma Fresh Day Serum offers a potent dose of Vitamin C, brightening skin and improving texture. It absorbs quickly and gives a healthy glow, though some may find it a bit strong initially.

Omg a vitamin c thats not sticky or stinky, great job! I have tried over 30 vitamin C products and this is the one! If you don't want to smell like burned hot dogs lol or be super sticky try this, very hydrating, brightening and works great on acne scars . Thank you for this amazing serum a keeper!

I was searching for a new vit c serum and found this one had the highest reviews. I would 100% buy this product over and over again.. I have very acne prone skin and combined this with my favorite acne gel and my skin has completely changed over the last month.. dark spots, large pores, acne marks all gone and my face is so glowy. Applies nicely and layers great. I did change up the sunscreen I was using because it did cause the serum to pill. Small adjustment later and now its a staple to stay! Finally comfortable leaving the house with no makeup!
I cannot be without this!! Fades my acne marks and I have noticed so much brighter skin. I love how it feels after applying too. The best vitamin C out there.
I love it sm ok? (lol I'm actually 10 and getting this for Christmas)

I've been searching for a good vitamin c serum that absorbs well and doesn't sit on top of my skin. This product seemed to be it. It absorbed really well, stung a little bit but felt nice overall. Over the next few days I had the worst breakouts I've had in years. I thought maybe I need to get used to it? Nope. Never happened. My skin looks awful right now, I feel like a teenager, self-conscious and covered in spots. It sucks because it's so highly rated and pricey. Not sure what's reacting so poorly with my skin, but buyer beware, keep the packaging until you know how it reacts with your skin.

I wish they would stop incentivizing reviews. I had a hard time finding any honest reviews from people who actually bought this product. However, I decided to go for it anyway because I normally love drunk elephants products. This product made me break out horribly. I stopped using it, and then started again and the break outs came back. The product also pills. I found it difficult to apply this product under other products, especially makeup. I didn't notice any brightening effects or anything along those lines, just breakouts.

I am a die-hard DE user and buy everything as soon as it is released. This serum is a rare hard pass for me. I just used it and it literally pills/rolls right off my face. I never return Ulta purchases because it's a hassle to drive there, but i am making an exception for this expensive waste of money.

My skin has been so much brighter since I've been using this for a few weeks! My acne scarring and dark spots are going away and I can't believe how great my skin looks! Will never not have this in my routine.
I would not recommend because you would have to go to the doctor to get it off

I love this vitamin C, I have tried the other one by drink elephant and it was good but not my favorite. This one suits my skin so much more. I've seen an overall smoother skin texture, brighter skin and hyperpigmentation has lessened. Also doesn't leave your skin feeling sticky which is great. This was gifted by drunk elephant but my review is my honest thoughts

avis.titre: The container is badly designed, so much of it goes to waste
avis.texte: the container for the serum is defective, as it leaks from the top every time I use it, leading to much of the product being wasted. I reached out to Drunk Elephant Support twice and never heard back from them. The product seems good but I won't buy again since it is really hard to use without it all falling out and the customer service was inexistent.

C-Luma Hydrabright Serum is wonderful. I wasn't sure if I would notice a difference with my skin cause I never have with vitaminC but this one has worked amazingly! When I put it on it the morning it makes my skin brighter right away! Gifted by drunk elephant

Gifted by Drunk Elephant. I love this new serum! It does not have that awful Vitamin C smell! And I saw some fading of past pimple marks. I think I will probably see more fading in the coming weeks. I no longer use two serums to fade marks and to hydrate because this C-Luma does both. I woke up and felt my skin was more hydrated and soft. I have used many Vitamin C serums in the past and this has been my favorite so far.

I'm not a paid 3rd party and I didn't receive this as a gift. Bought a full size. Gentle serum. Really does brighten. No synthetic fragrance. Not sticky/tacky. No breakouts. But - pills after a couple hours. I apply this serum first thing. Followed by Lala Retro moisturizer. I dont wear makeup. I am 43, very dry thyroid skin. Fine lines, & sun damage. This vitamin C is great for going low & slow.

Drunk Elephant gifted me the C-Luma Hydrabright Serum and here are my thoughts. First, my skin is sensitive/reactive and I typically like Drunk Elephant because their formulas work so well (although they are expensive). This serum has a gel consistency & gives my skin much needed hydration. I haven't had any reactions or sensitivity to this serum but I haven't used it long enough to see much improvement in fading post acne scars. My skin does look brighter though so I'll continue using this to see if any changes occur.

This vitamin C serum is like a brightening shot of confidence. It's potent and effective, helping to fade dark spots and even out my complexion. My skin looked radiant, almost like I had just had a good night's sleep—minus the party.

This product was great. I used it only in the mornings after washing my face and followed with my normal skincare routine. The serum was lightweight enough to be used daily. The pump was also really nice and is able to lock in place for travel. gifted by drunkelephant

Gifted by drunk elephant. I really like this vitamin c serum so far as its gentle enough for my sensitive skin. I do notice some brightening effects but will need to keep this in my routine to see if it fades my spots

This product didn't stand out to me in any way compared to other drunk elephant that o have used. Perhaps it's just not for my skin type or complexion, but I didn't notice any difference in my skin after use. I think you should give it a try still though as everyone's skin is different and I do love this brand! Gifted by drunk elephant

The C-Luma Hydrabright Serum was gifted by drunkelephant. I use the product at night and mornings and have noticed my skin tone is more even. Additionally, my skin looks hydrated and awake. I love to use this product prior to applying moisturizer.

avis.titre: The serum you didn't know you needed!
avis.texte: I was gifted by Drunk Elephant! I love their skincare products and was excited to try this serum. I love how light this serum feels when I apply it to my face. It keeps my face glowing and makes my face look brighter! I'd recommend!

Upon using this gentler vitamin c serum my fresh blemishes seem to begin fading. I will have to wait to see long term usage result on my older, darker blemishes. I think this vit c is much better for the sensitive skin types. Gifted by DrunkElephant

Gifted by brand. Drunk Elephant's C-Luna Hydrabright Serum has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. Unlike other vitamin C serums I've tried, this one is incredibly gentle on my sensitive skin. It has a lightweight, silky texture that absorbs beautifully without leaving any sticky residue, making it perfect for layering under my moisturizer. The results have been amazing—I've noticed my skin looks more radiant and healthy, with a nice even tone that wasn't there before. I definitely recommend giving this serum a try!

avis.titre: Perfect for post mace marks treatment
avis.texte: This product worked so well at helping diminish my post acne marks and also helped brighten my face as well. It was very easy on my skin and skin is usually sensitive so I definitely recommend it! Thanks fir being gifted by Drunk Elephant!

I love drunk elephant so I knew it wouldn't disappoint me. I've been using it for 2 weeks and have noticed a much brighter skin. I use it daily with a good spf. The ingredients are amazing. Would definitely recommend. Gifted by drunk elephant

Gifted by drunk elephant for my honest review and thoughts. If you have super sensitive skin like I do, this vitamin c is perfect for you! I am so happy to finally have a brightening product that doesn't irritate my skin

My skin is normal with a little bit on a dry side. I've tried this serum not too long ago and I love the results! It leaves my skin looking hydrated, bright with a healthy glow. I use it everyday as a part of my am skincare routine. Gifted by

I always prefer for my skin to be on the dewier side, so I appreciated being able to try out this serum and adjust it into my skincare routine with my other drunk elephant products. While I normally go for a cheaper option, this was a nice treat offered by drunkelephant.
Light and gentle alternative to the vitamin c serums I've used in the past. It absorbs and gives a glow to my skin without looking greasy. Layers well under my spf and makeup. Gifted by drunk Elphant

Drunk Elephant's Vitamin C serum has been a game-changer for my complexion. It brightens my face without any irritation, and I love how my skin absorbs it almost instantly. The texture is perfect—moisturizing yet light, making it a great base for the rest of my skincare routine. Gifted by drunkelephant

I was gifted by drunkelephant and I deeply enjoyed this product. I've been using the Drunk Elephant C-Firma Serum, and I really like it! It's great for brightening and firming my skin, plus it evens out my tone. The vitamin C is potent, so I noticed results pretty quickly. It's a bit on the pricey side, and you have to use it up fairly quickly after mixing, but honestly, it's worth it for how well it works.

My skin has a beautiful natural glow after using this product! It feels very nourishing and absorbs into the skin easily. I also enjoy that it adds a layer of protection against uv damage. I was gifted by drunk elephant and this is my honest review.

This serum has really been a great addition to my skin routine. It is very hydrating. It brightens my skin and it also helps. Keep it clear by clarifying it. I also love that the packaging is refillable. Absolutely amazing. I love it. Offered by drunk elephant.

I have noticed a significant improvement in the overall tone and texture of my skin since using this serum. It has helped to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, as well as improve the elasticity of my skin. Gifted by Drunk Elephant.

I love that it comes in an airtight pump bottle to protect the potency of the vitamin C and prevent oxidation.
